program.department: Environmental Systems Program (Scripps Institution of Oceanography, UC San Diego)

notes: Corroborated against the 2019-20 registrar catalog. CORRECTION: SIO 50 is NOT part of the Environmental Chemistry lower-division requirement and was removed (the page lists only BILD 3, CHEM 6A-B-C + 7L + 40A-B + 43A, PHYS 2A-B-C + 2CL, MATH 20A-D, ECON 1). Upper-division core (ESYS 101/102/103, ECON 131, POLI 160AA, CHEM 100A, CHEM 100B, ESYS 190A/190B) and the 3-of list of electives are verified verbatim. C- or better and letter grades required.

buckets.label: Physics sequence
buckets.note: All three required (this track uses the PHYS 2 series).

buckets.label: Additional lower-division chemistry & physics (track)
buckets.note: All required for the Environmental Chemistry track in addition to the core. CHEM 40A-B/43A = organic chemistry; 7L and 2CL are labs. (SIO 50 removed - not a requirement for this track.)

buckets.label: Senior Project & Senior Seminar
buckets.note: Capstone. 190A = two-quarter, 8-unit senior project; 190B = senior seminar.

buckets.label: Analytical & Instrumental Chemistry Labs (track core)
buckets.note: Both required for the Environmental Chemistry track.

buckets.label: Environmental Chemistry advanced electives
buckets.note: Choose 3 (verified verbatim). SIO 141=CHEM 174; MATH 183 (statistics) is upper-division.
